verdict.rationale: x402 is an open standard under vendor-neutral Linux Foundation governance. Its protocol SDK is on public npm from the x402 Foundation, and sellers run the payment-gating middleware on their own servers. Community operators run their own x402 gateways and endpoints. However, the documented flow relies on the hosted CDP Facilitator for verification and settlement, which is auth-gated. Nothing in the pack documents running your own facilitator. missing for 10: documented self-hostable facilitator (verify/settle) deployment, self-hosting guide, independent hands-on report of a fully self-hosted stack.
